# Speech test fixture

`sample_speech.ogg` is a short recording of the words “The Quick Brown Fox
Jumps Over The Lazy Dog.”

- Creator: RussmanJr
- Source: [Wikimedia Commons file page](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Audio_Sample_-_The_Quick_Brown_Fox_Jumps_Over_The_Lazy_Dog.ogg)
- License: [Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)

The recording is included here for exercising the transcription pipeline with
real speech. Please retain this attribution and license when redistributing it.
